data.long_meaning: Adniyyah is derived from the root 'Adna', meaning 'to serve'. This name signifies being a devoted servant to Allah, striving for His pleasure and following His guidance. The name Adniyyah carries the meaning “Servant of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Adniyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A constant reminder to serve Allah with sincerity and dedication.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adniyyah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

Ultimately, Adniyyah reflects the fundamental concept of submission and devotion to Allah in Islamic teachings.

historical_references.reference: The name Adniyyah is also associated with a famous mosque in present-day Saudi Arabia, which was built during the early Islamic period.
